title: 🖨️ Godela Launches "Godel-1" — AI That Designs Real Products From a Written Sentence!
body: 🖨️ Godela Launches "Godel-1" — AI That Designs Real Products From a Written Sentence!

San Francisco AI company Godela has developed a new platform called Godel-1 that generates designs for real products and tests them from written instructions alone, in a step that could cut much of the time needed to develop hardware.

The platform combines AI agents, computer-aided design software and physics simulation, evaluating factors such as airflow, heat, structural stress and manufacturability before an engineer touches any physical prototype.

The goal is for users to explore more engineering designs and improve them faster, instead of relying on long cycles of manual drawing and testing — the AI tries dozens of alternatives and rules out the weak ones early.

Simply put: you write what you want to build in a single sentence, and the AI draws the design and tests it physically before printing it; will the engineer soon become a reviewer of machine designs instead of their maker?
If you described a product in a single sentence, what would you ask AI to design for you?
